ethnicity.evidence_source: [/page/4/Text/6] For instance, for White participants the lag coefficient for smoking between Waves 4 and 6 is 0.685 (p<0.001), while for African American participants it is 0.861 (p<0.001), and for Hispanic participants it is 0.757 (p<0.001).
